## Sample

The quant-analyst agent reports the panel dimensions, the cell-size
threshold applied, and the number of exposed and unexposed IJVs.

## Baseline results

```{r}
modelsummary(models, estimate = "{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]", statistic = NULL)
```

For each hypothesis the agent states the pre-registered criterion from
`reviews/gate-5-pre-analysis-plan.md` and whether the estimate meets it:
supported, partially supported, or not supported.
